messages.subject: Circular plot question
parts:
Hi all,

Still working on graphing nightly activity patterns.

Had some great suggestions from several folks on the list.
Excellent help from David Kahle in particular.
So a great round of thanks again David.

Next question...

One area to explore for the temporal pattern display graphics would be to use a nightly circular plot summaries.
How would this also display Sun Set- Sun Rise and moon illumination?
With standard plots these could be lines for SS SR.

Seems  few programs do circular plots well (not including excel). I understand there is a pure circular stats program for Windows
called Orian. Have not looked at this.

I assume if it can be done at all it either has been or will be for R.
Is this an area where Hadley Wickham as the graphics/stats genius can develop if it does not exist?

a Package  "R-CirPlot" ???? Hmmmmm.

I am still on the steep end of the learning curve, but very keen to move up.

For an old dude... I keep the old adage in mind "It is never to late to teach an old dog new tricks... in just takes longer!"

Cheers from the jungles of Belize,

Bruce
